facts.value: The Electronic and Computer Engineering (ECE) degree programme has been developed in conjunction with employers to meet the demand for graduates with strong skills in computer software and electronic hardware engineering, along with mathematical analysis abilities, to support current and emerging societal needs.

The programme will support the development of skills required to develop and employ technologies to tackle many of the challenges of the coming decades including Internet edge devices, climate change, electric vehicles, sustainable development, energy, personalised health and well-being, and artificial intelligence, as well as other innovative areas such as entertainment and autonomous vehicles.

facts.value: An electronic component is any component, either active or passive, in an electronic system or electronic device.
Electronic circuit functions can be divided into two function groups: analog and digital.
Digital circuits are electric circuits based on discrete voltage levels and use Boolean algebra.
Ternary logic has been studied, but not gained any significant practical acceptance in computers.
Highly integrated devices aim to satisfy specified requirements of the user.
Present the fundamental concepts of basic electronics in an easy-to-understand and interesting manner.
Karl Ferdinand Braun's development of the crystal detector in 1874 inaugurated the field of electronics and the electron age.
The identification of the electron in 1897 by Sir Joseph John Thomson paved the way for the development of modern electronic devices.
Vacuum tubes were the first active electronic components which controlled current flow by influencing the flow of individual electrons.
The invention of the integrated circuit solved problems of size and complexity in electronic circuits, leading to smaller and more efficient designs.
